modelDescription: The Beretta A400 Solo is a modern semi-automatic shotgun designed to deliver reliable performance, smooth cycling, and comfortable handling. Built with Beretta’s renowned attention to quality and engineering, it offers a practical combination of durability, functionality, and refined design for hunters and shooting enthusiasts alike. Built for versatility in the field, the A400 Solo features Beretta’s B-LINK Pro gas-operating system for fast, reliable cycling and a Kick-Off Plus recoil reduction system for improved shooting comfort. Its Steelium barrel technology, adjustable stock fit, and durable construction make it a versatile choice for waterfowl hunting, upland game, and recreational shooting.
